questions.solution:
Rice is the example of the Kharif crop.

Similarly,

Cotton is the example of Cash crop.

Here, Wheat is an example of Rabi crop, Coconut is an example of plantation crop and fruit is an example of horticultural crop.

Oil is a product extracted from sesame seeds.

Similarly, Butter is a product extracted from milk, just like oil from sesame seeds.

Pulp is a part of the fruit, not something derived through processing in the same way oil is from sesame.

Leather and rubber are distinct materials.

Water might fill a hole, but the hole does not produce water.

Biotechnology is a scientific field applied within agriculture to improve crops, yield, and sustainability.

Veterinary science is a field that applies to animals for their health and treatment.

Animation is the study of Graphics.

Architecture is the study of designing, planning and construction of buildings.

Astronomy is the study of celestial objects.

Careful is the synonym of Hygienic.

Similarly,

Safe is the synonym of Hygienic.

Faultless is the synonym of Exact.

Similarly,

Grateful is the synonym of Thankful.

The movement of Monkey is climb.

The movement of Horse is gallop.

The movement of Rabbit is leap.

The movement of Deer is run/bound.

The movement of Dog is run.

Peacock is known for feathers.

Similarly, Elephant is known for trunk.

Owl is known for large eyes.

Turtle is known for hard shell.

Duck is known for webbed feet.

The motion of car is known as drive.

Similarly,

Airplane is operated by flying.

Boats typically sail or float on water.

Trains run on tracks.

Bullock carts are pulled or pushed usually by animals.

Forceful is the synonym of Powerful.

Similarly,

Demanding is the synonym of Challenging.

Minute is the synonym of Micro.

Similarly,

Frustrated is the synonym of Annoyed.

Cotton is the raw material that is used for making clothes.

Similarly,

Leather is a raw material used to make shoes.

Grass is not a raw material for making paints in any typical or meaningful context.

Thread is not a material typically used to make arrows.

Salt is not a material typically used to make oil.

Potato is the rich source of Starch.

Soil is the source of minerals but it is not consumed.

Egg is the rich source of protein.

Milk is the rich source of Protein.

Nature is the synonym of Ecosystem.

Similarly,

Theme is the synonym of Topic.

Expel is the antonym of Admit.

Similarly,

Cease is the antonym of Begin.

Calm is the antonym of Furious.

Similarly,

Similar is the antonym of Contrary.

A coconut is naturally enclosed in a shell.

Similarly, a corn is naturally covered by a husk, which is its outer layer.

The outer covering of banana is known as Peel.

The outer covering of Orange is known as Rind.

The outer covering of Apple is known as Layer.

An egg typically has an oval shape.

Similarly, a honeycomb is naturally made up of hexagonal shaped cells.

Television is generally rectangular in shape.

Scale is generally linear/rectangular in shape.

The shape of mountain is generally triangular/cone type.

Gloomy is the antonym of Cheerful.

Similarly,

Continue is the antonym of Terminate.

Humble is the antonym of Proud.

Similarly,

Generous is the antonym of Mean.

Insincere is the antonym of Serious.

Similarly,

Leader is the antonym of Follower.
